Players Committee card image of [[Slave I, Symbol Of Fear]] (original printing), game text: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Power +1 for each opponent's starship here. While Jango or Boba Fett piloting, immune to attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/slaveisymboloffear.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
